claim: The Framework's design principles and best practices are organized into six conceptual areas, the pillars: operational excellence, security, reliability, performance efficiency, cost optimization and sustainability.

evidence.quote: The general design principles and specific AWS best practices and guidance are organized into six conceptual areas. These conceptual areas are the pillars of the AWS Well-Architected Framework. These six pillars are operational excellence, security, reliability, performance efficiency, cost optimization, and sustainability.
